title: 第6章  抢我的，给我吐出来！
content_zh:
五百飞剑形成密密麻麻的剑网，对五位长老当头笼罩！
“联手！”
五人显然没料到，陆烬竟强大到连他们都忌惮的地步！
危急关头，几人也顾不了那么多，瞬间爆冲而出，以罗鹫为中心，形成了一个小型阵法，灵气呼啸爆发，在头顶凝聚一个倒扣巨碗型防御盾。
砰砰砰——
飞剑爆刺，轰鸣不绝！
轰击所产生的余浪席卷四方，那些观战弟子一个个心惊肉跳，满目惊恐！
陆烬所展现出来的恐怖实力，让人后背发凉。
他的战力，还要远超预期！
而随着轰鸣响彻，那剧烈声响早已传遍万剑宗。
不少人被这般动静吸引而来，人数越来越多。
在万剑宗极远处观战的紫阳门、狂刀门等门派强者，同样眸色诧异，显然没想到万剑宗突然发生的内斗，竟会越来越超出意料！
“这万剑宗内，到底怎么回事？那出关之人难道不是他们宗派之人？”
“这倒是有些奇怪，不过能看得出来，此人定是与万剑宗之人有仇，不然绝不会一出关就大开杀戒！”
“我等不能贸然进入万剑宗山门，只能暗中打探此人身份……”
“若此人彻底与万剑宗决裂，倒是有资格加入我狂刀门…”
这般惊天动地的打斗声，在吸引万剑宗越来越多的强者赶来的同时，在山门禁地深处，一位黑袍中年男子忽然睁开了眼睛。
此人豹头环眼，身材颀长，身上毫无灵气波动，可就那么站着，就有一种不容亵渎的威严。
“三年了……”
中年人嘴中嗫嚅，眸中精光闪烁，感慨一番后，眨眼原地消失。

飞剑如瀑！
当陆烬爆发出的五百飞剑全部轰入罗鹫等人头顶防御之时，那防御再也无法支撑，密密麻麻的裂纹宛若蛛网般急速扩散！
“好恐怖的力量！”
“诸位，这小子已经将我等逼入死地！再不拼死反击，还等什么！”
“扛不住了——”
噗通噗通——
当其中一名长老双膝跪地，口中喷血，所有防御土崩瓦解之时，其他长老也逐渐无法支撑，很快便全部跪倒，眸中惊恐越发浓烈！
死亡气息萦绕，所有人肝胆欲裂！
“陆烬！你想残杀我等长老！”
罗鹫深感恐惧，强忍飞剑重压，咆哮威胁。
“给我跪下！”
陆烬声音森寒，随着话音落下，防御盾轰然炸碎！
罗鹫长老也噗通一声跪在地上，口中鲜血喷薄而出，整个人气息登时萎靡下去！
一番交手，五人全部跪地，嘴中溢血不止！
“这怎么可能！”
“五位长老联手都不是他对手！简直难以置信！”
“罗鹫长老可是金丹境！如今连金丹境都不是他对手了！他到底强大到了什么程度？”
“不好！他真要杀了长老？？？”
“……”
观战者无不惊恐！

视线里，陆烬头顶凝聚五把飞剑，对准了五名长老，杀机森森！
“陆烬！你不能杀我！我可是内门长老！”
罗鹫彻底怕了，惶恐不安！
其他四人也吓得全身哆嗦，陆烬有如此战力，杀他们，易如反掌！
“只能你们杀我，不能我杀你们？没这道理！”
话音未落，五把飞剑直刺而出！
“放肆！”
就在这时，一声暴喝传来，那声浪在灵气的包裹之下若洪钟大吕，振聋发聩！
与此同时，数道剑气精准无误电闪而至，将陆烬的五把飞剑顷刻震碎！
两道人影自半空掠来，见到来者，众人大喜！
“是峰主和圣女！”
“峰主终于来了！”
“陆烬死定了！”
看到来人，那罗鹫等长老也是松了口气。
刚那一瞬，几乎必死无疑，当真是在鬼门关前走了一遭！
“姬峰主！”
罗鹫踉跄来到姬邀月跟前，开始将发生之事说给她听。
而此时，陆烬的眸色从姬邀月脸上扫过去，然后定在柳如烟身上。
瞬间，他拳头紧握，内心的仇恨骤然翻涌如浪！
“柳如烟！”

他一双眸子变得血红如修罗！
三年了，终于再次见到这个差点将自己坑死的恶毒女人！
柳如烟的眸子也看向了陆烬，眼神复杂，有惊讶，有恼怒，更多的，却是杀意！
她没想到，三年过去，那个废物竟会强势归来。
更没想到，狐师让她抢夺的那大机缘之人，竟是自己一心要斩草除根的人！
他身上到底发生了什么？
“陆烬！你这勾结魔族的叛徒，还敢回来！”
柳如烟率先发话了，声音不容置疑，高高在上，直接将罪名死死安在陆烬身上。
听闻此话，陆烬眸色冰寒：
“柳如烟！”
“你还真是无耻到让人发指！”
“当初你和那杨巅峰联手害我，一剑破我丹田，挖我至尊骨，又将我推入魔窟深渊，企图让我死无葬身之地！”
“见我活着归来，又污蔑陷害，说那些被你们坑死的同门乃是我勾结魔族一手造成！”
“柳如烟，如今当着万剑宗上下，你可敢对天发誓，说你是清白的？”
陆烬话语铿锵，听得不少弟子都面色微变。
甚至一些弟子也终于了然，毕竟三年前，陆烬可是内门第一，是不少弟子心中的偶像，而且他行事光明磊落，战力强大斩妖除魔除暴安良，乃是万剑宗英雄式的人物，不少弟子都心生崇拜。
可就因为一场魔窟之行，他就成了十恶不赦的罪人，这的确让不少弟子一时间无法接受。
可奈何随着柳如烟修为日渐强大，陆烬又一直失踪，他们也似乎逐渐接受了这个事实。
却没想到，陆烬有朝一日强势归来，似乎真相就要大白于天下！
“放肆！！”

陆烬话落，那罗鹫竟是一声暴喝，如今有姬邀月撑腰，他自是不惧：
“陆烬，如今如烟贵为我万剑宗圣女，岂容你如此栽赃陷害！你若敢再大放厥词，我万剑宗上下，必将你斩杀！”
陆烬冷冷看了他一眼：
“老狗，这没你说话的份！”
罗鹫咬牙切齿，却没敢再说，而是看向了姬邀月。
姬邀月眸中寒光闪烁，忽然爆喝：
“给我跪下！”
话音刚落，一股灼热灵气宛若赤龙，爆冲而来！
陆烬一惊，龙膜闪现，身形却依旧被震退十几丈！
姬邀月身为六品金丹强者，她的一道随手攻击，便让人难以招架！
可当看到陆烬仅仅被逼退十几丈后，她的眸子也浮现一抹意外！
陆烬的境界看上去就是灵珠五重，可他的防御力竟强大到让她有些想不通。
寻常五重灵珠境，在她这般攻击之下，必定重伤跪地！
而他却毫发无损！
在场众人也无不愕然，议论纷纷。
“这家伙有点手段，被六品金丹的姬峰主攻击，竟还能站着！”
“有意思！只可惜，就算他手段再多，也无法跟姬峰主抗衡！”
“我反而觉得他很男人！有仇必报，无畏生死！”
“小声点！你这是要忤逆圣女么！”
“……”

众人议论间，陆烬的眸色却也浮现出一抹异样。
就在他接下姬邀月这道攻击的瞬间，一股怪异力量被葬天棺吞噬了！
而当这股力量反哺进入丹田之时，他意外地发现，这其中竟有一股异火之力！
“异火？原来如此！”
他忽然眯眼一笑，这才想起，圣女峰峰主姬邀月，非但是一位灵气修士，还是一位炼丹师！
而她之所以成为炼丹师，并不是因为精神力特别强大，而是早年间偶然得到一簇异火。
刚刚的攻击之中，竟夹杂着一丝异火之力，而这，正好可以用来催发葬天棺给予的武学，孽火镇狱剑！
心神一动，那股异火力量在丹田灵珠之中，通过大衍化龙诀，开始逐步衍生！
有如此机缘，他自然不会错过！
而且，孽火镇狱剑一旦能够催发施展，这也将是他的最大底牌！
“师尊，让我来！”
见陆烬竟接下了姬邀月的攻击，柳如烟眸色微动，站到前方：
“没想到，三年不见，你这废物居然又有了修为，陆烬，三年前你罪大恶极，三年后，你同样死罪难逃！”
柳如烟高高在上，说话颇有圣女那不容亵渎的范儿。
“身为圣女，我有责任为万剑宗铲除祸害！”
说着，她周身气息爆发，竟是直逼二品金丹的气息！
她之前便是一品金丹巅峰，虽被雷劫重伤，却在洗髓池中得到极大好处，甚至气息比起之前还要强大一筹！
只是……
若是放在之前，她如此年轻就拥有这般强大的修为，定会引得无数弟子尖叫。
可当众人亲眼见证了一品金丹的罗鹫长老，联合其他四名长老都被陆烬强势打压之后，非但没有惊喜，反而隐隐地为她感到担忧。

似乎，陆烬已经有了与她抗衡的资本。
“哼，柳如烟，我的至尊骨，好用么？”
陆烬看着气息凛然的柳如烟，笑声如冰刀。
柳如烟暗暗磨牙，却根本不会正面回应，话语依旧义正词严：
“休要花言巧语！既然你想知道至尊骨的力量，今日，我便用它来杀你！”
看着她那决绝的神色，陆烬眸色森冷，全身杀意滚滚，灵气自丹田灵珠释放，滚滚如流，冲上头顶，化作五百飞剑虚影。
“柳如烟，三年前你抢我的，今日，全给我吐出来！”
content_en:
Five hundred flying swords formed a dense sword net, covering the five elders!
"Join forces!"
The five of them obviously didn't expect that Lu Jin would be so powerful that even they were afraid of him!
At the critical moment, a few people couldn't care less, and rushed out in an instant, forming a small formation with Luo Jiu as the center. The spiritual energy roared and exploded, condensing an inverted giant bowl-shaped defensive shield above their heads.
Bang bang bang——
The flying sword explodes and stabs, roaring continuously!
The remnants of the bombardment swept across all directions, and the disciples watching the battle were all frightened and terrified!
The terrifying strength displayed by Lu Jin sent chills down people's backs.
His combat power far exceeds expectations!
And as the roar resounded, the violent sound had already spread throughout Wanjian Sect.
Many people were attracted by such movements, and the number of people increased.
The strong men from the Ziyang Sect, Kuangdao Sect and other sects who were watching the battle from far away were also surprised. Apparently they did not expect that the sudden internal fighting in the Wanjian Sect would become more and more unexpected!
"What's going on in the Wanjian Sect? Isn't the person who came out of seclusion a member of their sect?"
"This is a bit strange, but it can be seen that this person must have enmity with the people of Wanjian Sect, otherwise he would never go on a killing spree as soon as he comes out of seclusion!"
"We can't rush into the Wanjian Sect's mountain gate, we can only secretly find out this person's identity..."
"If this person completely breaks with the Wanjian Sect, he is qualified to join our Crazy Sword Sect..."
Such earth-shattering sounds of fighting attracted more and more powerful men from the Wanjian Sect. Deep in the mountain gate forbidden area, a middle-aged man in black robes suddenly opened his eyes.
This man has a leopard-like head and ringed eyes, a tall and slender figure, and no spiritual energy fluctuations on his body, but just standing like that, he has a majesty that cannot be blasphemed.
"Three years..."
The middle-aged man muttered, his eyes flashed, and after sighing, he disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Flying swords like waterfalls!
When the five hundred flying swords exploded by Lu Jin all hit the defense above the heads of Luo Jiu and others, the defense could no longer support it, and the dense cracks spread rapidly like a spider web!
"What a terrifying power!"
"Everyone, this kid has already driven us to death! If we don't fight back desperately, what are we waiting for!"
"I can't bear it anymore——"
Thump thump thump——
When one of the elders knelt on his knees, blood spurted from his mouth, and all defenses collapsed, the other elders gradually became unable to hold on, and soon they all fell to their knees, with more and more fear in their eyes!
The smell of death lingers, and everyone's liver and gallbladder are about to burst!
"Lu Jin! You want to kill us and other elders!"
Luo Jiu was deeply frightened. He endured the heavy pressure of the flying sword and roared threats.
"Kneel down!"
Lu Jin's voice was cold, and as he finished speaking, the defensive shield exploded into pieces!
Elder Luo Jiu also knelt on the ground with a thud, blood spurted out from his mouth, and his whole breath suddenly withered!
After a fight, all five of them knelt down, with blood bleeding from their mouths!
"How is this possible!"
"The five elders working together are no match for him! It's unbelievable!"
"Elder Luo Jiu is in the Golden Core Realm! Now even the Golden Core Realm is no match for him! How powerful is he?"
"No! He really wants to kill the elder???"
"..."
The spectators were all horrified!
In his sight, five flying swords gathered above Lu Jin's head, aiming at the five elders with murderous intent!
"Lu Jin! You can't kill me! I'm an elder of the inner sect!"
Luo Jiu was completely frightened and uneasy!
The other four people were also trembling with fear. Lu Jin had such fighting power, it would be easy to kill them!
"You can only kill me, but I can't kill you? That doesn't make sense!"
Before he finished speaking, five flying swords pierced out!
"Presumptuous!"
At this moment, a loud shout came, and the sound was like a bell under the aura, deafening and deafening!
At the same time, several rays of sword energy came with lightning accuracy, instantly shattering Lu Jin's five flying swords!
Two figures came from mid-air and saw who was coming., everyone was overjoyed!
"It's the Peak Master and the Saint!"
"The Peak Master is finally here!"
"Lu Jin is dead!"
Seeing the person coming, Luo Jiu and other elders also breathed a sigh of relief.
At that moment, death was almost certain, and he was really on the verge of death!
"Master Ji Peak!"
Luo Jiu staggered to Ji Yaoyue and began to tell her what happened.
At this time, Lu Jin's eyes swept across Ji Yaoyue's face, and then fixed on Liu Ruyan.
In an instant, he clenched his fists, and the hatred in his heart suddenly surged like a wave!
"Liu Ruyan!"
His eyes turned as red as Shura!
Three years later, he finally saw this vicious woman who almost killed him again!
Liu Ruyan's eyes also looked at Lu Jin, with complex expressions ranging from surprise to anger, but more importantly, murderous intent!
She didn't expect that after three years, that loser would come back strong.
What's more, she didn't expect that the person with great opportunity that Master Fox asked her to snatch was actually the person she wanted to eradicate!
What happened to him?
"Lu Jin! You, a traitor who colluded with the demons, dare to come back!"
Liu Ruyan was the first to speak, with an unmistakable voice and a superior voice, directly placing the blame on Lu Jin.
Hearing this, Lu Jin's eyes turned cold:
"Liu Ruyan!"
"You are so shameless!"
"Back then, you and Yang Dingfeng teamed up to harm me. You broke my Dantian with one sword, dug out my Supreme Bones, and pushed me into the abyss of the Demon Cave in an attempt to make me die without a burial!"
"Seeing that I came back alive, you slandered and framed me again, saying that those fellow disciples who were tricked to death by you were the result of me colluding with the demons!"
"Liu Ruyan, in front of everyone in the Wanjian Sect, do you dare to swear to God that you are innocent?"
Lu Jin's words were so sonorous that many disciples' expressions changed slightly.
Even some disciples finally understood. After all, three years ago, Lu Jin was the number one in the inner sect and was the idol of many disciples. Moreover, he was upright and aboveboard, had strong combat power, killed demons and violence, and was a heroic figure in the Ten Thousand Swords Sect. Many disciples admired him.
But just because of a trip to the devil's cave, he became a heinous sinner, which indeed made many disciples unable to accept it for a while.
However, as Liu Ruyan's cultivation became stronger and stronger, Lu Jin continued to disappear, and they seemed to gradually accept this fact.
But he didn't expect that Lu Jin would come back strong one day, and it seemed that the truth would be revealed to the world!
"Presumptuous!!"
After Lu Jin finished speaking, Luo Jiu shouted violently. Now that Ji Yaoyue was backing him, he was not afraid:
"Lu Jin, now that Ru Yangui is the saint of my Wan Jian Sect, how can I allow you to frame me like this! If you dare to speak nonsense again, I, the Wan Jian Sect, will definitely kill you!"
Lu Jin gave him a cold look:
"Old dog, you have no business talking about this!"
Luo Jiu gritted his teeth, but did not dare to say anything more. Instead, he looked at Ji Yaoyue.
Ji Yaoyue's eyes flashed with cold light, and she suddenly shouted:
"Kneel down!"
As soon as he finished speaking, a scorching spiritual energy rushed over like a red dragon!
Lu Jin was startled, the dragon membrane flashed out, but his figure was still knocked back more than ten feet!
As a sixth-grade golden elixir expert, Ji Yaoyue's casual attack would be hard to parry!
But when she saw that Lu Jin was forced back only a dozen feet, a hint of surprise appeared in her eyes!
Lu Jin's realm seemed to be at the fifth level of the Spiritual Bead, but his defense was so strong that she couldn't figure it out.
Ordinary fifth-level spirit bead realm, under such an attack from her, would definitely be seriously injured and kneel down!
And he was unscathed!
Everyone present was stunned and started talking about it.
"This guy has some tricks up his sleeve. He was attacked by Peak Master Ji of the sixth-grade golden elixir, but he was still standing!"
"Interesting! It's a pity that no matter how many tricks he has, he can't compete with Peak Master Ji!"
"On the contrary, I think he is very manly! He must avenge himself and is fearless of life and death!"
"Keep your voice down! Are you going to disobey the Saint?"
"..."
While everyone was discussing, LuThere was something strange in Jin's eyes.
The moment he received Ji Yaoyue's attack, a strange force was swallowed up by the Sky Burying Coffin!
And when this power fed back into his Dantian, he unexpectedly discovered that there was actually a force of strange fire in it!
"Strange fire? That's it!"
He suddenly narrowed his eyes and smiled, and then he remembered that Ji Yaoyue, the master of Saintess Peak, was not only a spiritual monk, but also an alchemist!
The reason why she became an alchemist was not because of her particularly strong mental power, but because she accidentally obtained a bunch of strange fire in her early years.
The attack just now was actually mixed with a trace of strange fire power, and this can be used to activate the martial arts given by the Sky Burial Coffin, the Evil Fire Suppressing Prison Sword!
With a thought, the strange fire power began to gradually derive from the Dantian Lingzhu through the Dayan Transformation Dragon Art!
Given such an opportunity, he would naturally not miss it!
Moreover, once the Evil Fire Suppressing Hell Sword can be activated, it will also be his biggest trump card!
"Master, let me come!"
Seeing that Lu Jin actually took Ji Yaoyue's attack, Liu Ruyan's eyes moved slightly and she stood in front:
"I didn't expect that after three years of not seeing each other, you, this loser, would actually develop your skills again. Lu Jin, three years ago you committed a heinous crime, and three years later, you will be equally guilty of death!"
Liu Ruyan was aloof and spoke like a saint who could not be blasphemed.
"As a saint, I have the responsibility to eradicate harm for Wanjian Sect!"
As she spoke, the aura around her exploded, and it was the aura of a second-grade golden elixir!
She was at the peak of the first-grade golden elixir before. Although she was seriously injured by the thunderstorm, she benefited greatly from the marrow washing pool, and her aura was even stronger than before!
Just...
If it were before, she would have made countless disciples scream if she had such a powerful cultivation at such a young age.
But when everyone witnessed Elder Luo Jiu, a first-grade golden elixir, and the other four elders being forcefully suppressed by Lu Jin, instead of being surprised, they felt vaguely worried for her.
It seemed that Lu Jin already had the capital to compete with her.
"Hmph, Liu Ruyan, is my supreme bone useful?"
Lu Jin looked at Liu Ruyan, who had an awe-inspiring breath, and laughed like an ice knife.
Liu Ruyan grinded her teeth secretly, but she would not respond directly at all, and her words were still righteous:
"Stop talking nice words! Since you want to know the power of the Supreme Bone, I will use it to kill you today!"
Looking at her determined expression, Lu Jin's eyes were cold, and murderous intent was rolling all over his body. The spiritual energy was released from the Dantian Lingzhu, rolling like a stream, rushing to the top of his head, turning into the shadow of five hundred flying swords.
"Liu Ruyan, you robbed me three years ago. Today, spit it all out!"
